messages:
Maya (AE): FYI RiverRun wants a 6mo pilot on private deployment. asking: 30% off list, waive onboarding fee, and ability to convert to 12mo at a favorable rate. procurement says they need PO by Fri EOD.
Lucas (RevOps): what's list for their config?
Maya (AE): private VPC, reserved 2xA100 equiv, managed support = $110k/mo list. 30% -> $77k/mo.
Anika (Security): they also uploaded a long security questionnaire and want reduced data logging. we'll need completed attestation and network allowlist before start.
Ravi (Eng): infra can stand it but reserved capacity lead time is ~2 weeks. We could propose a fast-start on shared host for first 72h then migrate to dedicated.
Maya (AE): drafting two options to share with buyer tonight:
Option 1: 25% off for 6mo pilot, onboarding fee waived, conversion window 45d with a conversion credit equal to 50% of pilot fees applied as a dollar credit to first invoice after conversion.
Option 2: 18% off for 12mo commit, $30k onboarding credit, plus $12.5k/mo compute-offset credits for pilot spikes.
Lucas (RevOps): finance floor is 20% for pilots w/out upfront commit. Anything below needs deal desk. 25% is allowable if we get conversion intent + PO deadline enforced.
Maya (AE): can we make the 25% conditional: PO by Fri (ts: 1745123499), signed conversion intent (non-binding) within pilot, and security attestation uploaded within 10 days?
Anika (Security): yes attach clause: "onboarding fee waived contingent on receipt of completed security attestation and network allowlist within 10 days; service start conditional on attestation."
LegalBot: flagged: "conversion credit" language ambiguous. Recommend: "Conversion credit — dollar credit equal to 50% of total pilot invoices, capped at $150,000, applied to first post-conversion invoice."
Ravi (Eng): operational note: if onboarding waived, add "standard onboarding work to be scheduled within 5 business days; expedited path available for an additional ops fee."
Maya (AE): buyer pressure is high. they said competitor is offering faster start but higher price. I'd like to escalate for 25% conditional approval.
Lucas (RevOps): I can provision conditional approval for a one-off 25% pilot discount if the following are met: 1) PO received by EOD Fri (1745123499), 2) conversion intent signed within pilot to convert to 12mo at list price (or agreed delta), 3) security attestation uploaded within 10 days. If any condition fails, discount void and standard billing applies. I'll log the deal desk ticket now.
Maya (AE): great — I'll send the term sheet with LegalBot language and include the compute-offset as a line item with dollar equivalent.
Maya (AE): (later) forwarded email from RiverRun procurement: "We will prioritize PO for Friday. Security team will upload questionnaire tomorrow AM."
Lucas (RevOps): please paste draft terms here once updated. I'll attach to ticket.
Maya (AE): pasted draft snippet: `Compute-offset credits: 250k token equivalent per month, dollar equivalent $12,500/mo, expires at pilot end, non-refundable.`
Lucas (RevOps): okay add credit cap language and ensure invoice line shows dollar credit.
Anika (Security): I'll fast-track review once they upload. ping me.
LegalBot: contract template updated with clarified conversion credit, onboarding scheduling clause, and conditional waiver language.
Maya (AE): thanks all. will update thread when PO arrives. :crossed_fingers:
